contexts.text: The sons of Gomer: Askenas, Riphath, and Togarmah () = those who had external worship, but derived from that which existed with the nation Gomer. Askenas, Riphath, and Togarmah were so many nations with whom there was such worship, by which nations are also signified so many doctrinals, which were rituals, derived from the external worship with Gomer. AC 1153. AC 1154.
The house of Togarmah () had rites which regarded spiritual (as distinguished from celestial) things.
The house of Togarmah (), in the opposite sense, = perverted doctrinals.
